aries:
♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through Leo in Purva Phalguni in your 5th house, joined by Jupiter in early Leo, while the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus cluster in Libra in your 7th. Mars remains in late Cancer in your 4th. This is a fire–air day for you: enthusiasm for pleasure, creativity and risk blends with heightened awareness of partners and agreements. Home and family under Mars can feel touchy, but the Leo Moon invites you to bring warmth and playfulness back into your life.

💼 Career: 5th-house activation favors projects that require originality, performance, teaching or speculative vision. You may feel pulled to take a creative gamble at work—proposing a bolder concept, altering how you present your skills, or re-framing a stagnant project. The Libra 7th-house stellium, with Mercury and Venus retrograde, points strongly toward renegotiating terms with clients, business partners or collaborators rather than pushing solitary agendas. Old proposals or shelved collaborations can be revisited with more balanced expectations. Be cautious about letting domestic irritations (Mars in Cancer) spill into professional conversations; ground yourself before important calls.

❤️ Love: The Leo Moon in your 5th turns up romantic magnetism and a desire for affection that feels playful, not heavy. If you’re partnered, there can be a strong pull to recreate the feeling of early dating—fun outings, light-hearted teasing, shared enjoyment—especially if recent weeks have felt serious. The Libra 7th focus, however, keeps reminding you that reciprocity and fairness matter: how decisions are made, whose schedule is honored, how apologies are handled. If single, chemistry is likely with people who appreciate your boldness yet meet you with social grace and emotional maturity. Past relationship topics may resurface for review; handle them as information, not destiny.

💰 Money: With Jupiter highlighting your 5th, it’s easy to lean toward speculative spending—on hobbies, children, dating, or ventures that feel exciting. Some risks can be fruitful over the long term, but the Libra 7th emphasis suggests double-checking the financial side of any joint venture or shared cost. Review contracts, profit splits and informal promises under the retrogrades; this is a good day to correct imbalances in how gains and responsibilities are shared. At home, Mars in the 4th can push for expenses on repairs or comfort items; prioritize what protects stability rather than impulsive upgrades.

🧘 Advice: Let joy and creativity lead, but let partnership realities set the frame. Before saying yes to a bold move, ask how it affects the people whose support you rely on most.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your fire shines brightest today when the people you burn for feel clearly chosen—not accidentally scorched.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni lights up your 4th house of home, inner security and emotional roots, while expansive Jupiter sits at the very start of Leo there. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus (your ruler) in Libra energize your 6th house of work, routines and health. Mars in late Cancer charges your 3rd house of communication and local movement. The sky pulls you toward tending your nest and simultaneously refining the way you move through each day.

💼 Career: With three planets in your 6th, today is excellent for practical problem-solving and quietly powerful improvements. You’re supported in re-designing workflows, clarifying roles with colleagues, and revisiting how much time and energy different tasks truly deserve. The Leo Moon in your 4th suggests that the quality of your base—your workspace, your home environment, your emotional state—directly affects your performance. Simple adjustments such as reorganizing a corner of your home office or setting clearer boundaries around interruptions can have outsized impact. Mars in your 3rd lends courage to address misunderstandings or speak up where expectations have been vague, though you’ll want to temper any impatience in tone.

❤️ Love: Emotional comfort takes precedence over spectacle. The 4th-house Moon can highlight how safe and appreciated you feel in private, behind closed doors, beyond social presentation. Venus retrograde in your 6th points to subtle imbalances in daily give-and-take: who remembers small details, who takes on boring chores, who adjusts more to the other’s schedule. If partnered, talking about everyday rhythms—meal times, digital boundaries, household habits—can bring your connection back into gentle harmony. If single, attraction may arise with someone you encounter regularly in ordinary spaces: commuting, errands, or through work. Pay attention to how grounded and at ease your body feels around them.

💰 Money: The Libra 6th-house emphasis encourages you to examine recurring expenses, work-related costs and the link between your effort and what you’re paid. This is a supportive day to refine service packages, adjust pricing, or ask for more balanced compensation structures—especially for tasks that drain you. The Leo 4th activation can draw spending toward home, family or property. Focus on upgrades that genuinely support rest and stability, rather than purely decorative splurges. Mars in your 3rd also hints at possible short trips or tech purchases; choose what meaningfully improves your daily logistics.

🧘 Advice: Treat your home, body and calendar as one integrated ecosystem—every small adjustment to one part ripples through the rest.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The success you’re building now grows best in a life that feels livable, not just impressive from the outside.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni moves through your 3rd house of communication, learning and short journeys, while Jupiter also occupies early Leo here. The Sun, your ruler Mercury (retrograde), and Venus (retrograde) gather in Libra, activating your 5th house of creativity, romance and self-expression. Mars in Cancer energizes your 2nd house of money, speech and values. Your mental and expressive channels are lively, with a strong undertone of reassessing what you truly enjoy and value.

💼 Career: With your ruler retrograde in the 5th, this is a day for revisiting, re-editing and refining creative or client-facing work rather than aggressively launching new initiatives. The Leo 3rd-house Moon supports writing, teaching, presenting and networking with confidence and flair; you can make a persuasive impression if you back your charm with clear facts. It’s an excellent window for reviewing marketing copy, reviving a half-finished proposal, or reconnecting with an earlier collaborator whose style still resonates. Mars in your 2nd can sharpen both your negotiating instincts and your impatience around being undervalued. Prepare your numbers and examples, then communicate calmly rather than reacting in the moment.

❤️ Love: Libra in your 5th makes romance and pleasure a central theme, but with both Venus and Mercury retrograde, much of the story involves revisiting what has and hasn’t worked before. Old romantic ideas, forgotten crushes, or previous versions of your own artistic self may return to consciousness. The Leo 3rd Moon favors heartfelt messages, meaningful conversations and perhaps planning a short outing or local adventure with someone you care about. If partnered, discussing what actually feels fun now (as opposed to old habits) can refresh your bond. If single, you might be drawn to witty, expressive people you meet through classes, online spaces, or neighborhood activities.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd can bring an urge to act quickly on money matters—chasing payment, cutting off a draining arrangement, or investing in skills and tools. Combined with the 5th-house Libra emphasis, there’s temptation to spend on experiences, creative gear, entertainment or children. Choose purchases that either build your talents or create genuinely nourishing joy, not just distraction or status. Retrograde Venus is helpful for re-assessing subscriptions, side hustles or income streams that were meant to be fun but now feel unbalanced.

🧘 Advice: Notice which conversations today leave you feeling more alive and capable, and which leave you tense; let that guide where you invest your mental energy going forward.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your words carry extra color now—use them to paint the life you actually want, not just to describe the one you’ve outgrown.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni travels through your 2nd house of income, values and self-worth, with Jupiter at the very beginning of that same sign amplifying the theme. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra light up your 4th house of home, family and emotional foundations, while Mars continues in late Cancer in your 1st house, keeping your drive—and sensitivity—high. The focus shifts toward the relationship between what you have, where you live, and how you feel in your own skin.

💼 Career: This is a grounded day for realistic yet hopeful evaluation of your skills and resources. The Leo 2nd-house Moon can boost confidence to discuss pay, fees or budgets, or to seek roles that better reflect your abilities. With the Libra stellium in your 4th, professional decisions are closely tied to home and family dynamics: you may be rethinking remote work boundaries, considering a move that affects your commute, or adjusting your schedule to better support domestic responsibilities. Retrograde Mercury and Venus favor revisiting old arrangements about working from home, revising agreements with family members about shared space, or returning to a past project that could now provide more stable income. Mars in your 1st gives you courage but can also make you prickly if you feel taken for granted; choose clarity over defensiveness.

❤️ Love: Emotional safety is a central theme. The 4th-house Libra activation highlights the feel of your shared space—its aesthetics, fairness in chores, and the tone of conversations. With Venus retrograde, you’re prompted to notice subtle resentments or patterns where you’ve smoothed things over instead of asking directly for what you need. The 2nd-house Leo Moon emphasizes feeling valued through consistent, heartfelt actions. If partnered, gently discuss what helps each of you feel at home together—not just physically, but emotionally. If single, you may feel drawn to people who offer warmth and reliability, or who share a connection to your family or hometown.

💰 Money: Jupiter and the Moon in your 2nd can bring opportunities to expand income over time or to see new ways of using your talents. They can also inflate generosity and spending impulses. You may feel prompted to treat loved ones, improve your living space, or invest in something that promises more security. The Libra 4th-house stellium supports reviewing mortgages, lease terms, shared household costs or family financial expectations. Use the retrograde window to clarify who contributes what and to untangle any vague obligations you’ve been carrying quietly.

🧘 Advice: When your instinct is to protect everyone else first, pause long enough to ask what would truly protect your own sense of stability today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The foundation you’re building now grows stronger each time you let your worth shape your home life—not just the other way around.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your sign in Purva Phalguni, bringing emotional warmth and a desire for ease and pleasure, while Jupiter sits in early Leo in Magha, expanding your sense of possibility about who you can be next. The Sun in Libra with retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus occupies your 3rd house of communication and mindset. Mars in late Cancer heats up your 12th house of the subconscious and endings. You are luminous today, but there’s also a subtle pressure to process what you’re carrying behind the scenes.

💼 Career: With both the Moon and Jupiter in your 1st house, visibility and influence are amplified. Others notice your demeanor, your choices and even your moods. This can support leadership moves, presentations or negotiations where confidence matters—provided you’re grounded in facts. The Libra 3rd-house stellium pushes you to refine how you express yourself: your writing, messaging, and informal conversations. Retrograde Mercury and Venus are ideal for revising important documents, re-framing pitches, or reconnecting with contacts you haven’t spoken to in a while. Mars in your 12th is a reminder that unacknowledged stress or resentment can leak through tone and timing; build brief pauses into your day to release tension before important interactions.

❤️ Love: The Moon in your sign heightens emotional needs and makes you more open, even dramatic, in affection. You may crave being seen and cherished without having to work so hard for it. Jupiter nearby tends to bring warmth and generosity to your heart, but can also encourage idealizing a person or story. The Libra 3rd emphasis is about talking through stories—how you and a partner narrate your shared history, how you interpret recent events, what scripts you’re still following from past relationships. If partnered, a candid but gentle conversation about how you each feel heard (or not) can reset the tone. If single, you’re likely to attract attention through your voice, social media presence, or local activities, not just through appearance.

💰 Money: Direct financial emphasis is lighter today, but your 3rd-house Libra planets may bring up decisions about courses, devices, transportation or communication tools that carry price tags. Retrogrades support getting better deals, trading or selling unused items, and revisiting old plans for learning that could enhance your earning power. The Leo 1st activation might nudge you toward spending on your image or comfort; choose what genuinely supports confidence in daily life rather than momentary display.

🧘 Advice: Honor the part of you that wants to bask and enjoy—but also listen for the quieter signals from your inner world about what needs rest or closure.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your presence turns heads today, but the real shift happens when your outer shine starts following your inner truth, not the other way around.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni moves through your 12th house of rest, release and the unconscious, while Jupiter at the start of Leo also occupies this hidden sector. Your ruler Mercury, retrograde in Libra and joined by the Sun and retrograde Venus, activates your 2nd house of money, values and self-worth. Mars in late Cancer stimulates your 11th house of friends, communities and long-term aims. You’re in a quiet but potent review phase: questioning what truly matters and which alliances support that.

💼 Career: With the Moon and Jupiter in your 12th, your best work today may involve strategy, behind-the-scenes tasks, research, and tying up loose ends rather than pushing for public breakthroughs. There can be insights about where energy is leaking—projects that no longer fit, roles that drain you more than they reward you. The Libra 2nd-house stellium asks pointed questions about value: Are your current responsibilities reflected accurately in your compensation? Does your work honor your evolving standards? Mercury and Venus retrograde support re-evaluating rates, renegotiating agreements, or reactivating a dormant income stream that aligns better with your priorities. Mars in your 11th can stir both motivation and conflict in group settings; choose carefully which collective efforts are truly worth your finite energy.

❤️ Love: Emotional processing is likely to happen in a more private, introspective way under a 12th-house Moon. Old memories, unfinished conversations or subtle disappointments may surface in dreams or quiet moments. Rather than trying to solve everything with your mind, give feelings space to move through. The Libra 2nd emphasis turns attention toward how valued and respected you feel in relationships—through practical actions, not just words. If partnered, calm discussion about shared budgeting, division of daily efforts, or how you each acknowledge the other’s contributions can be productive. If single, you may notice a shift away from relationships that require you to over-function or prove your worth.

💰 Money: With the Sun and two retrograde benefics in your 2nd house, this is an important time for financial recalibration. Today is particularly good for reviewing past spending patterns, subscriptions, and lingering obligations, as well as following up on money owed. You may spot ways to simplify and make your financial life lighter without sacrificing true comfort. The 12th-house Leo Moon and Jupiter draw attention to hidden expenses—impulsive late-night purchases, generous but untracked support for others, or vague commitments. Mars in your 11th could push investments or spending linked to social causes or online projects; ensure they align with both your ideals and your practical limits.

🧘 Advice: Build a little unstructured time into your schedule and watch what your attention naturally drifts toward—that’s where your deeper priorities are trying to speak.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The adjustments that change your future most are often the ones you make quietly, when you finally trust your own sense of what is and isn’t worth it.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni joins Jupiter in your 11th house of networks, aspirations and community, while the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in your own sign put intense focus on identity and self-direction. Mars in late Cancer activates your 10th house of career and public standing. You’re standing at a pivot point where social opportunities, personal reinvention and professional ambition all intersect.

💼 Career: With Mars high in your chart and the Moon–Jupiter pair in your 11th, ambition and visibility are amplified. This can be a productive day for engaging with organizations, industry groups, mentors or audiences that can support your trajectory. Networking, even in modest ways, may open doors in coming weeks. Meanwhile, the stellium in your 1st house asks you to reconsider how you present yourself professionally: your role, title, visual style, and boundaries around what you will and won’t take on. Retrograde Mercury and Venus favor updating portfolios, reworking your elevator pitch, and revisiting prior career paths or contacts that may be newly relevant. Avoid making big decisions from a place of defensiveness if authority figures press your buttons; aim for grounded self-assertion.

❤️ Love: With so much energy in your sign, you are more aware of your own needs and non-negotiables. You may feel less willing to disappear into someone else’s preferences. The Leo 11th-house Moon suggests that friends, community events or social media can play a role in your love life today—either as spaces where connection arises, or as mirrors reflecting your evolving standards. If partnered, there can be discussions about how your individual goals fit into shared plans: relocation, career changes, or public-facing choices. If single, you may gravitate toward people who appreciate your independence and social grace, and who show up consistently within their own circles.

💰 Money: Financially, the 11th house relates to earnings through career progression, organizations and networks. The Leo Moon with Jupiter there points to potential long-term growth through aligning with the right teams or communities, even if immediate gains are modest. The Libra 1st-house focus, however, reminds you to keep financial goals congruent with your evolving identity; a version of success that used to appeal might not fit as well now. Mars in your 10th can bring conversations about bonuses, leadership stipends or performance-linked pay; negotiate from a clear sense of your contributions, not from comparison.

🧘 Advice: Before saying yes to another role or group, check whether it reflects the person you’re becoming—not just the one you’ve been.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The balance you seek today lies in honoring your own direction even as you step more boldly into the circles that can help you grow.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni crosses your 10th house of career, reputation and responsibility, with Jupiter at the start of Leo magnifying your public presence. At the same time, the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra occupy your 12th house of retreat, introspection and closure. Mars, your traditional ruler, continues in late Cancer in your 9th house of beliefs, learning and horizons. You’re navigating a tension between showing up visibly and listening to quieter internal shifts.

💼 Career: The Leo Moon at the top of your chart can bring attention to your work—through meetings, deadlines, public interactions or leadership opportunities. You may be called to take charge or to represent your team. Jupiter’s presence suggests that these efforts can contribute to longer-term growth, though sometimes by expanding your responsibilities. Meanwhile, the Libra stellium in your 12th speaks of cycles ending or being reconsidered behind the scenes: a project winding down, an old role you’re emotionally releasing, or private doubts about a path you’ve outgrown. Retrograde Mercury and Venus make this an excellent day for quiet clean-up work—correcting old errors, resolving confidential matters, or having discreet conversations about future directions. Mars in your 9th can inspire decisive moves around study, training or travel that support the next chapter.

❤️ Love: With 12th-house activation, part of your love life is unfolding in dreams, private reflections or unspoken longings. You may find yourself reviewing how past relationships shaped your trust, forgiveness and boundaries. The Leo Moon in your 10th can also highlight how your relationship appears publicly: social media presence, family opinions, and how well your partnership fits into your broader life path. If partnered, gentle honesty about what you want from the future—where you might live, how you balance work and intimacy, what kind of shared adventures matter—can deepen understanding. If single, you may feel drawn to someone you meet in educational, spiritual or cross-cultural settings (Mars in the 9th), but you might also sense the need to clear old emotional residue before diving in.

💰 Money: The Leo 10th-house emphasis often corresponds with financial themes tied to status shifts—promotions, higher-profile assignments, or new responsibilities that could increase income over time. The Libra 12th planets point toward background costs and confidential financial matters: debts, legacy arrangements, or quiet support you give others. Retrograde Venus in the 12th is helpful for re-evaluating these hidden entanglements, perhaps consolidating obligations or setting healthier limits around what you give without acknowledgement.

🧘 Advice: Make space today for both action in the outer world and honest check-ins with your inner world; ignoring either side will leave you feeling off-balance.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real authority now grows each time your public choices answer to the private truths you can no longer push aside.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni moves through your 9th house—your natural terrain of wisdom, travel, teaching and higher perspective—while your ruler Jupiter anchors the first degrees of Leo there. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 11th house of networks, communities and aspirations. Mars in late Cancer energizes your 8th house of shared resources and emotional depth. Big-picture thinking is lit up, but it needs to engage with the realities of collaboration and shared stakes.

💼 Career: This is a powerful day for long-range planning, learning and strategic recalibration. The 9th-house Moon–Jupiter combo encourages you to look at where your work is heading over the next few years: Are you aligned with meaningful projects? Do you need further training, certification or a shift in environment? The Libra 11th-house stellium emphasizes the people and structures that can help you get there—friends, professional associations, online communities, mentors. With Mercury and Venus retrograde, it’s ideal for reconnecting with past allies, revisiting old goals, or reshaping your role within a group. Mars in the 8th adds intensity around joint ventures, budgets and power dynamics; scrutinize terms and timelines carefully before making commitments that bind you closely to others.

❤️ Love: Your attention leans toward shared ideals and future vision rather than purely immediate emotion. The Leo 9th Moon can bring conversations about beliefs, life philosophy and what “adventure” means in relationships. The Libra 11th emphasis blurs the lines between friendship and romance; you may feel drawn to someone in your wider circle or realize that your relationship needs more shared community and social life. If partnered, dreaming together about travel, projects or learning experiences can re-invigorate your bond. If single, look for people whose values and curiosity resonate with yours, not just those who share a hobby or spark.

💰 Money: Mars in your 8th house focuses attention on shared financial matters—debts, inheritances, joint accounts, business partnerships or pooled resources. Discussions may feel charged but can be productive if you stay factual and avoid blame. The Libra 11th-house planets point toward income or expenses linked to groups, subscriptions, memberships and collective ventures. Retrogrades support reviewing past agreements with friends or organizations, updating terms, or gently disentangling yourself from arrangements that no longer feel fair.

🧘 Advice: Let your vision stretch farther than usual, then invite the right people into the plan and be willing to adjust the route based on what shared resources can actually support.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The paths that truly belong to you now are the ones where your ideals, your people and your practical limits can all walk together.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni highlights your 8th house of shared resources, psychological depth and transformation, with Jupiter at the start of Leo intensifying these themes. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 10th house of career, status and long-term responsibility. Saturn, your ruler, continues its slow journey through Pisces in your 3rd house of communication, while Mars in late Cancer moves through your 7th house of partnerships. It’s a day of significant, though not necessarily dramatic, reconfiguration of your bonds and obligations.

💼 Career: The Libra stellium at the top of your chart keeps career questions in sharp focus. You may be revisiting your role description, considering a title change, or quietly rethinking your trajectory. Retrograde Mercury and Venus are favorable for reworking agreements, renegotiating terms with employers or clients, or updating how your contributions are recognized. The Leo 8th-house Moon suggests that behind-the-scenes matters—budgets, profit-sharing, funding, and power dynamics—are especially important now. You might uncover useful information about how resources actually flow in your organization. Mars in your 7th amplifies both collaboration and conflict with key individuals; approach negotiations with firmness and respect, aiming for solutions where responsibility is clearly shared.

❤️ Love: With Mars in your 7th and the Moon in your 8th, relational intensity is real. Surface politeness may not be enough; deeper needs around trust, mutual support and emotional honesty are activated. Patterns of who takes on more emotional or practical burden may become more obvious. If partnered, today can support one focused, sincere conversation about a sensitive topic—finances, intimacy, or unspoken resentments—as long as you frame it as a shared problem, not an accusation. If single, you may feel drawn to intense, charismatic individuals; let Saturn in your 3rd remind you to listen closely to their words and observe consistency over time.

💰 Money: The 8th-house Moon–Jupiter emphasis spotlights shared and complex finances: loans, insurance, taxes, inheritances, or business investments. This is a strong day for reviewing terms, understanding your real exposure, and making incremental adjustments. You might have an opportunity to restructure a debt or clarify what portion of a joint asset is effectively yours. The Libra 10th-house planets connect money to your professional standing; discussions about bonuses, equity or performance-based rewards are possible, though under retrogrades they’re better framed as reviews and adjustments than sudden demands.

🧘 Advice: When high-stakes topics arise, lead with clarity and a willingness to share responsibility—your steadiness is more persuasive than any ultimatum.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your strength today lies not in carrying everything alone, but in calmly redefining what you will—and will not—carry with others.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni moves through your 7th house of partnerships, key clients and one-to-one interactions, joined in the broader sign by Jupiter in early Leo. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra light up your 9th house of beliefs, learning and broader perspective. Saturn in Pisces continues steady work in your 2nd house of finances and self-worth, while Mars in late Cancer energizes your 6th house of work and routines. Other people feature prominently in your day, but what you believe about relationship and service is quietly evolving.

💼 Career: The Leo Moon in your 7th brings important conversations with collaborators, managers, clients or partners. Someone may ask more of you, or you may find yourself in the role of motivator. Jupiter’s presence in Leo emphasizes the potential for mutually beneficial, long-term alliances—but also warns against over-promising. The Libra 9th-house stellium asks you to reassess the guiding principles behind your work: ethics, mission, and your appetite for growth or change. With Mercury and Venus retrograde, this is an excellent time to revisit contracts, refine proposals, and reconnect with mentors or institutions that once inspired you. Mars in the 6th gives you energy to tackle tasks, but can heighten irritability in the workplace; channel it into process improvements instead of criticism.

❤️ Love: Relationships, whether romantic or platonic, take center stage. The 7th-house Moon can bring warmth, generosity and renewed enthusiasm to existing partnerships, but also spotlights any imbalance of attention or appreciation. The Libra 9th influence nudges you to consider whether your relationships support your larger sense of meaning: Do you and your partner encourage each other’s growth? Do you feel free to explore, learn and express your beliefs? If partnered, discussions around travel, future plans, or shared study can deepen your bond. If single, you may meet interesting prospects through classes, cultural events, or circles connected to spirituality or learning.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd continues to emphasize steady, disciplined financial habits. The Leo 7th Moon and Jupiter can bring financial themes into relational contexts—negotiating fees, adjusting shared costs, or defining the financial side of collaborations. This is a favorable time to bring more structure and clarity to such arrangements. The Libra 9th-house emphasis may involve spending or earning related to courses, certifications, travel or legal matters. Under retrogrades, review terms carefully and prefer upgrading existing commitments over adding multiple new ones.

🧘 Advice: When interactions feel intense, look for the belief underneath—about fairness, freedom or responsibility—and work on that level rather than getting stuck in surface disagreements.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that truly help you grow now are the ones where your vision is taken seriously—not just your usefulness.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni moves through your 6th house of work, health and daily service, with Jupiter at the start of Leo expanding this area over the longer term. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 8th house of shared resources, emotional intimacy and deeper transformation. Saturn in your sign continues to firm up your boundaries, while Mars in late Cancer energizes your 5th house of creativity, children and romance. It’s a day where practical effort and honest emotional engagement are closely linked.

💼 Career: The Leo Moon in your 6th can bring enthusiasm and a desire to perform well in your daily tasks. You may take pride in solving problems, organizing systems or stepping up where others have dropped the ball. Jupiter’s broader transit here suggests that building strong work habits now can yield larger opportunities later. The Libra 8th-house stellium, with both Mercury and Venus retrograde, points to a need to revisit contracts, budgets, and shared responsibilities at work: who owns what part of a project, how profits or credit are divided, and whether confidential matters are being handled fairly. This is a favorable moment to quietly renegotiate imbalances and to follow up on resources or support that were promised but never fully delivered.

❤️ Love: Mars in your 5th livens up passion, playfulness and creative expression, making you more inclined to seek joy and connection. At the same time, the 8th-house Libra activation draws your attention to the more vulnerable sides of relationship—trust, sharing, and how you both handle fear and insecurity. If partnered, small, concrete gestures of support—help with a task, thoughtful questions about something your partner is carrying—may mean more than grand romantic statements. Honest, calm conversations about intimate or financial concerns can deepen trust if you stay curious rather than defensive. If single, you might feel drawn to someone met through collaborative efforts or shared problem-solving, where you see how they handle responsibility.

💰 Money: With three planets in your 8th, shared and complex finances are a key focus: loans, taxes, partner income, inheritances, or joint investments. Retrograde Venus and Mercury make this an ideal time to review old agreements, update percentages or timelines, and gently correct arrangements that have drifted out of balance. The Leo 6th-house Moon may also highlight job-related expenses, health investments, or tools that support your effectiveness. Spending on something that genuinely improves your wellbeing or efficiency can be worthwhile, provided it fits within the sober boundaries Saturn in your sign is trying to maintain.

🧘 Advice: Let your practical choices today align with the deeper kind of life you’re trying to build—one where responsibility, joy and honest connection all have a place.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The transformation you’re in now advances every time you treat the small tasks and shared conversations as sacred, not secondary.
